- Build a complete, playable 3D open-world taxi game in a GTA-inspired style.

- User requested: “3D open world в стиле GTA с такси-миссиями.”
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them on completion.

## Decisions
- Built a Russian-language browser game with procedural nighttime city streets, taxi driving, pickup/drop-off missions, cash and ride tracking, minimap, and keyboard/touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html` and `game.js` implementing the game.
- Started a local HTTP server on port 3002 and opened the game in Playwright.
- Verified `node --check game.js` passed and captured an initial screenshot at `screenshots/game.png`.
- Tuned scene lighting and added instanced road lane markings after inspecting the initial dark screenshot.

- Validate the latest lighting and lane-marking changes in-browser; final screenshot and gameplay checks remain.

### Blocked
- (none)

1. Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/game.png` after the latest reload and inspect the scene.
2. Check `playwright-cli console` for new errors, then test driving and mission progression.
3. Finish with a brief summary of the game and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI, styles, HUD, minimap, and touch controls.
- `game.js`: Three.js city generation, taxi driving, missions, HUD updates, and rendering.

## Important Context
- Latest `game.js` changes include stronger ambient/directional lighting, brighter materials, two window levels, disabled shadows, removed per-lamp point lights, and instanced road dashes.
- Latest reload completed; no post-change screenshot or gameplay validation has been done yet.
- Changes are uncommitted.
